milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the pink concrete pillar (center at spawn-relative [5.5, 1, 3.5]) and face toward it, modeling 'the player can see the target.' The pink concrete is ~6.5 blocks from spawn, so max_distance=16 is generous enough to allow the agent to spot it from moderate range, while facing_tolerance=60 ensures the agent is actually looking at the pink concrete rather than something else. This is preferred over position_inside_box because the task is about finding/observing, not just reaching a location.

scene_description: A small outdoor area with several structures and animals on a grass platform. The player spawns facing roughly north-east. A 2x2x3 pink concrete pillar is placed at ~5,0,3 to ~6,2,4 (about 6 blocks from spawn to the right-forward). Additional landmarks include an oak planks shed (at ~-4,0,6 to ~-2,2,8 with a door), a cobblestone hut with oak slab roof (at ~-6,0,-4 to ~-4,2,-2 with a door), a crafting table (at ~3,0,-3), a cow (at ~-1,0,4), and a sheep (at ~2,0,-1). These distractors create visual variety and mild navigational complexity without obscuring the target pink concrete.
task_text: Find the pink concrete blocks in the scene.
design_notes: The pink concrete pillar (2 wide x 2 deep x 3 tall) is placed about 6 blocks from spawn at a slight angle to the right-forward. It is highly visible due to its bright pink color contrasting with the natural green/brown environment. The scene includes distractors (animals, other structures) to make the task non-trivial. The area is cleared of air above the grass floor to ensure unobstructed views. The pink concrete center is at approximately (5.5, 1, 3.5) relative to spawn. Verified via sandbox that all 12 commands execute successfully and the pink concrete is visible from spawn (seen in exploration step 000). The agent in the preview got distracted by the sheep but the pink concrete remained visible on the right edge of the frame throughout the exploration.
